name: InsightIQ
description: Built a full-stack AI-powered economic insights platform that transforms natural-language questions into interactive FRED visualizations using React, Express, semantic retrieval, and Gemini-generated analysis.

Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using PostgreSQL, pgvector, local Xenova embeddings, and FRED metadata/tags to retrieve relevant economic indicators while reducing hallucinated or invalid LLM-selected series IDs.

Created an offline indexing workflow that synchronized over 200K national and state-level FRED series, enriched selected series with official metadata and tags, generated vector embeddings, and indexed them for semantic search.

Designed an Express.js orchestration layer that performs vector retrieval, validates annual FRED observations, and orchestrates Gemini to generate grounded chart-level insights and dashboard summaries.

name: Releasetrain.io
description: Developed an ML/NLP pipeline for automated risk detection from unstructured data, including preprocessing and TF-IDF feature engineering.
Defined labeling guidelines and annotated 4,000+ samples, improving data quality and reducing bias.
Achieved 97% accuracy and 67% F1-score through hyperparameter tuning, improving model performance and reliability.

name: Sproutly
description: Built a real-time dashboard for an IoT-based smart watering system, enabling live sensor monitoring and automated 15-minute status updates.
Led a 4-member team in designing the frontend architecture and containerizing the application with Docker for streamlined deployment.

name: Emergency Traffic Priority System
description: Built a reinforcement learning–based V2X simulation for emergency vehicle routing in urban traffic to optimize response time and routing efficiency in critical scenarios.
Reduced emergency response time by ~4.8%, improving routing efficiency across training episodes.
Achieved ~8% lower latency vs rule-based approaches, improving efficiency and responsiveness in vehicle communication systems.
